svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1301 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-22 through 2026-10-13 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-13T16:23:52.025Z.
